description: This file defines the AppEnv class responsible for loading environment variables, particularly BASE_URL, from .env and .env.example files. It handles fallback logic if the environment files are missing or incomplete.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A utility class for loading and managing environment configuration variables.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env file, with fallback to .env.example if necessary.
